protocol.outer_cv: StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0) by subject = seed_noise_band fold_id
protocol.inner_cv: StratifiedGroupKFold(4, shuffle=True, random_state=outer_fold) on outer-train subjects (same as merge_best_window6)
protocol.deep_inner_models: train on inner-train; early stopping (val AUC, patience 8, max 50 ep) on first split of SGKF(5, shuffle, rs=100*fold+inner) of inner-train subjects; predict inner-val -> inner OOF logit
protocol.deep_outer_model: train on FULL outer-train fold for fixed epochs = median best_epoch of the 4 inner models (min 5), no early stopping; predict test fold (deviation from raw_waveform_window6, which trained on 3/4 of outer-train with early stopping on the remaining 1/4)
protocol.preprocessing: per window demean, /std, clip +-10; augmentation/TTA identical to raw_waveform_window6
protocol.hybrid: ResNet1d trunk (128-d pooled) + MLP on 86-d broadband_shape_features (standardized with the training set of each model, clip +-10; Dropout.1-64-BN-ReLU-Dropout.3-32-ReLU), concat 160 -> Dropout.3 -> Linear
protocol.seed_aggregation: mean logit over seeds for both inner OOF and outer test
protocol.cpu_members: C4 + bb_lr inner OOF recomputed with merge_best_window6.task (deterministic); outer scores reused from merge_best_window6_oof.npz member__*
protocol.fusion: per member per outer fold z = (logit - mu)/sd with mu/sd from inner OOF on outer-train; equal-weight mean
protocol.threshold: bacc_at0: fixed 0; bacc_train_thr: Youden threshold on fused inner-OOF z of outer-train
protocol.bootstrap: subject-level, 2000 draws, seed 20261029, shared draws, delta = combo - REF
